generalPolicies.earlyCheckinPolicy: Early check-in from 10:00 AM is complimentary subject to room availability upon arrival; guaranteed early morning check-in requires reservation from the preceding night.
generalPolicies.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation is permitted up to 24-48 hours prior to the scheduled check-in date. Cancellations made within the late cancellation window incur a 1-night room charge.
generalPolicies.childPolicy: Children up to 5 years stay free sharing existing bed with parents. For children aged 6 to 12 years, extra bed is ₹1,000 INR per night (Room Only) or ₹1,200 INR per night with breakfast.
generalPolicies.extraAdultPolicy: Extra adult (12+ years) is ₹2,000 INR per night with roll-away extra bed included.
generalPolicies.freePickupPolicy: Complimentary airport and railway station pick-up service is provided on the condition that the guest pays the mandatory parking toll of ₹485 INR directly. Up to 30 minutes driver waiting time from landing/arrival is included; waiting time exceeding 30 minutes will incur actual parking authority charges payable by the guest.
generalPolicies.outsideFoodPolicy: Outside food and online food deliveries (Swiggy, Zomato, etc.) are strictly prohibited in guest rooms and dining areas under FSSAI and hotel hygiene guidelines. In-house cutlery and crockery will not be provided for outside food. 24-hour in-house room service is available.
generalPolicies.couplePolicy: Valid government-issued photo ID (Passport, Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License) is required for all adult guests at check-in. Local unmarried couples may be restricted per hotel safety guidelines.
generalPolicies.petPolicy: Godwin Hotels does not allow pets in guest rooms or dining areas, with the exception of certified service animals.
generalPolicies.smokingPolicy: All indoor guest rooms and restaurants are 100% non-smoking; designated outdoor rooftop smoking zones are provided.
generalPolicies.diningPolicy: 24-hour in-house room service is available for all guests to order food in their room at any time of day or night. The Indian Grill is open daily from 07:30 AM to 11:00 PM (last order taken at 10:45 PM). Lavish multi-cuisine buffet breakfast is served daily from 07:30 AM to 10:30 AM at The Indian Grill restaurant and is included in all Bed & Breakfast room rates. Coffee Brownie boutique cafe is open daily from 08:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
generalPolicies.parkingPolicy: Valet parking assistance and secure parking arrangements are provided for registered hotel guests.
